description: All-in-one Android widget (KWGT, 4×6) for the sky of the day at the phone's position: Sun and Moon rise and set, Moon phase, dusk and astronomical night, tonight's sky rating /100, sky events of the day, astronomy word of the day with a Wikipedia link, and an 'on this day' fact from the history of astronomy. Red at night. Texts in French.
name: Widget Éphéméride astro
releaseNotes: Version 2.0: all-in-one layout (4×6) with tonight's sky rating, word of the day and 'on this day' (633 facts). The compact 4×4 layout remains available as ephemeride-4x4.php.
